Thick leather gloves worn smooth by a lifetime of felling trees. Whoever Paul was, he hit hard.

Axe and chainsaw hits have a 20% chance to knock zombies and animals down. +25% wood harvest.

Counts toward the Lumberjack full set bonus.

A preacher's finest suit, still pressed and spotless. Folks say the man who wore it could heal the sick, and maybe they were right.

Every zombie you kill heals you and your party members within 15 meters for 5 health over 5 seconds.

Counts toward the Preacher full set bonus.

Thin, supple gloves made for quick fingers and quiet work. No lock or crate stands in your way for long.

Lockpicking is 50% faster and breaks 50% fewer lockpicks. Searching containers is 25% faster.

Counts toward the Rogue full set bonus.

Top-of-the-line running shoes from a marathon that never got to finish. They still want to go the distance.

Sprinting uses 30% less stamina. Jump 30% higher. Falls hurt as if they were 4 meters shorter.

Counts toward the Athletic full set bonus.

Sharp sunglasses that once belonged to a man who never paid full price for anything. Traders still seem to remember them.

Trader quests let you choose one extra reward. 10% better prices when buying and selling.

Counts toward the Enforcer full set bonus.

Mud-caked rubber boots from a farm that fed half the county. Plants just seem to grow better around them.

Every crop you harvest has a 25% chance to give a bonus crop and a 25% chance to give a bonus seed.

Counts toward the Farmer full set bonus.

A road captain's leather vest, covered in patches from rides that ended badly for everyone else. It's at its best when things look worst.

Below half health you take 20% less damage and deal 20% more melee damage.

Counts toward the Biker full set bonus.

Scratched goggles held together with tape and stubbornness. Through them, every pile of junk looks like treasure.

Find better loot (+10% loot stage). Scrapping items is 50% faster.

Counts toward the Scavenger full set bonus.

Worn leather gloves from the last lawman in the county. His hands never shook, and with these on, neither will yours.

The .44 Magnum, pipe pistol and lever-action rifle deal 35% more headshot damage and reload 15% faster.

Counts toward the Ranger full set bonus.

A battered flak vest from a sergeant who walked out of every firefight. When things get desperate, it kicks in.

Dropping below 30% health gives you 10 seconds of 25% damage resistance and 20% faster running. Recharges after 2 minutes.

Counts toward the Commando full set bonus.

A dark hood from someone nobody ever saw coming. Wear it and you'll be just as hard to spot.

Sneak attacks deal 50% more damage. You are 25% harder to see.

Counts toward the Assassin full set bonus.

A dented hard hat from a wildcat miner who struck it rich more than once. It has a nose for ore.

+25% ore and stone from mining. Mining tools use 25% less stamina.

Counts toward the Miner full set bonus.

Sun-bleached wraps from a wanderer who crossed every wasteland on foot. Neither heat nor cold bothers whoever wears them.

+30 heat and cold resistance. Food and water drain 20% slower.

Counts toward the Nomad full set bonus.

A lucky cap from a genius who never took it off. Everything just makes a little more sense with it on.

+10% XP from everything. Crafting is 20% faster.

Counts toward the Nerd full set bonus.

Steel-shod raider boots built for kicking down doors and standing your ground. Nothing knocks you off your feet in these.

You can't be knocked down or stunned. 30% less damage from explosions and 50% less from land mines.

Counts toward the Raider full set bonus.
Your flak vest can't kick in again until this runs out.
